title: Introduction: Making Valuation Datasets AI-Usable
text: Hi, I'm Molly. This video is about making this data set usable by something other than me. Two pieces, a readonly server and I assistant can query directly and a frozen JS contract another system can parse without guessing. Up to now, everything here was a script I run and a document I read. Fine for building it, useless to anyone else. Two deliverables, a server with six tools, none of which writes anything, and a signal file frozen at version 1.0. The hard part was never the protocol. title: Safety First: Why Zero Tools Are Allowed to Write Decisions - Grounding Checks & Catching Ranking Hallucinations
text: Style structure. These filings give a funds share count, never the company's total shares. Where a figure is withheld, the reason is a value, not a missing key. Four companies are suppressed this quarter, and two counts here disagree on purpose. The server lists 11 companies. The signal publishes 10. The 11th has zero marks. An empty answer is still an answer and the server says so rather than returning nothing. The quarterly note is the only proza model writes here and it gets the computed figures and nothing else. No database, no tools. I expected one check to be enough. No number that is not in the figures. It was not. A draft passed cleanly and still said one company had the fewest marks.
